verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say an intention can start from a feedback report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes tasks. That is AI turning feedback into a feature-like work item. There is no evidence that it detects insights across many feedback items or links feedback to existing related feature ideas, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: automatic insight extraction across feedback, linking or grouping feedback to existing related ideas, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on AI to automatically detect insights within feedback and link them to related feature ideas

citations.quote: An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
